basic_details.job_title: IIT Kanpur Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) has announced 1 vacancy for the post of Project Associate-I under advertisement number P.Rect./R&D/2026/203. The engagement is purely on a temporary and contractual basis initially for a period of one year or end of the project, whichever is earlier. The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 37000/- and applicants must hold a Postgraduate degree. important_dates.interview_date: Short Listed candidates will be informed with an email about the date of interview

how_to_apply: Prepare your CV, educational qualification certificate, and experience certificate.
Compose a new email addressed to [email protected].
Set the email subject strictly as 'Application for the Position of Project Associate-I'.
Attach your CV, educational qualification certificate, and experience certificate to the email.
Send the email on or before 23 October 2026.

Room Temperature Hydrogen Gas Sensor by Utilizing 2d Multicomponent Quasicrystalline Alloys

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the minimum educational qualification and meet the desirable skills and experience specified for the Project Associate-I post. Minimum Qualification: Postgraduate. Desirable Skills and Experience: M. Tech / M. Sc in Materials Science and Engineering / Metallurgy / Chemistry / Physics. At least 3 years of laboratory experience. Hands-on experience on characterization material facilities.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of 37000/-. The appointment is purely on a temporary and contractual basis initially for a period of one year or end of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kanpur Project Associate-I
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV, educational qualification certificate, and experience certificate. Compose a new email addressed to [email protected] . Set the email subject strictly as 'Application for the Position of Project Associate-I' . Attach your CV, educational qualification certificate, and experience certificate to the email. Send the email on or before 23 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection will be based on Online Interview through Google Meet/Zoom/Skype. Short Listed candidates will be informed with an email about the date of interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Associate-I under the project entitled “Room Temperature Hydrogen Gas Sensor by Utilizing 2d Multicomponent Quasicrystalline Alloys”.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 01 position available for the Project Associate-I post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to send applications via email is 23 October 2026.

faq.answer: Minimum qualification is Postgraduate, with desirable qualifications including M. Tech / M. Sc in Materials Science and Engineering / Metallurgy / Chemistry / Physics.

faq.answer: At least 3 years of laboratory experience and hands-on experience on characterization material facilities are listed as desirable skills and experience.

faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive 37000/- Consolidated salary.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Interested candidates should send an email to [email protected] with their CV, educational qualification certificate, and experience certificate by October 23, 2026, with the email SUBJECT AS 'Application for the Position of Project Associate-I'.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Selection will be based on Online Interview through Google Meet/Zoom/Skype. Short Listed candidates will be informed with an email about the date of interview.

faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.
